name: 3.0.2 - Bugfix Release
body:
_Exosphere: A simple CLI and TUI driven application that offers patch reporting for remote unix systems_

A minor change in dependencies to prevent an incompatible version of a library from being used, as well as URL changes for docs and home page.

## New website

Exosphere now has a mini-site at [exosphere.tools](https://exosphere.tools).
The documentation has been re-homed under [docs.exosphere.tools](https://docs.exosphere.tools) for consistency, although previous readthedocs links should still continue to function.

A few internal changes also improve how this information is shared between the components that make use of it, to ease any further change of that kind.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where Exosphere would pull an incompatible version of a dependency on install through `pipx` or `uv tool`, resulting in exit code changes.

## What's Changed

* Project: Change homepage and docs urls by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/369
* Update documentation URLs by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/371
* Docs: Update spellcheck words list by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/372
* Update lockfile dependencies by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/377
* Deps: restrict cyclopts to <5.0.0 by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/385
* 3.0.2 Release Prep by @mrdaemon in https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/pull/386


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/mrdaemon/exosphere/compare/v3.0.1...v3.0.2
